dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicaid beneficiaries seeking foot and ankle care and Medicare beneficiaries with diabetes requiring therapeutic shoes.
dimensions.evidence: to ensure access by Medicaid beneficiaries to appropriate quality foot and ankle care

dimensions.assessment: Expands provider recognition under Medicaid and clarifies documentation rules for diabetic footwear under Medicare.
dimensions.evidence: recognizing doctors of podiatric medicine as physicians under the Medicaid program

dimensions.assessment: Implies federal and state fiscal adjustments due to expanded Medicaid coverage of podiatric services and Medicare documentation changes.
Amends titles XVIII and XIX of the Social Security Act regarding health program definitions and documentation requirements.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XIX of the Social Security Act... to amend title XVIII of such Act

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory changes to Medicare and Medicaid program rules with an effective date starting in 2026 for Medicaid and 2028 for Medicare.
dimensions.evidence: shall apply to services furnished on or after January 1, 2026

missing_information: Congressional Budget Office cost estimates for the Medicaid and Medicare program changes.
importance_detail.rationale: Modifies Medicaid coverage to include physician services delivered by podiatric physicians and adjusts Medicare documentation requirements for diabetic therapeutic shoes.
